svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Component · Output approval · photo · approved · narrow
svg.desc: Mirrors GalleryPreviewPanel.sourceApprovalRow (App/GalleryPreviewPanel.swift, 2026-11-05; docs/approved-assets.md) — the project's own approval, under Output's buttons in both dresses, for a Photo capture (the picture as the editor shows it: it follows the edits) or a video (the source clip as it is). Never for an interval shoot, whose source is frames, nor a scan. One button, the whole row: HStack(alignment: .top, spacing: 10) of the seal (17 pt medium in a 22 pt column — checkmark.seal in secondary at rest, checkmark.seal.fill in LL.accent once approved), the title 14 pt semibold over the caption 11.5 pt secondary (2 apart, wrapping in a 236 pt column: 302 − 24 padding − 22 − two 10 pt gaps), padded 12 × 9 on primary at 6 % — LL.accent at 10 % once approved, the title then reading Approved in LL.accent — radius 9. Height = 9 + 17 + 2 + 14 per caption line + 9. A press toggles (model.setApproved). THIS STATE: a Photo capture, approved: capture.approvedAt is set and the app keeps a full-size render current. 65 pt tall. See components/README.md.

g.text: The photo as you edit it — every change
goes with it. Click to remove.
